name: nails-by-alynna
description: Nails by Alynna — mobile-first booking PWA (React + Vite frontend, Node.js + MongoDB API, Cloudflare Workers)

scripts.setup: yarn install && yarn --cwd backend install && yarn --cwd frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "yarn --cwd backend dev" "yarn --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.typecheck: yarn --cwd backend typecheck && yarn --cwd frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: yarn --cwd backend lint && yarn --cwd frontend lint
scripts.test: yarn --cwd backend test && yarn --cwd frontend test
scripts.build: yarn --cwd backend build && yarn --cwd frontend build
scripts.check: yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn test && yarn build
